name: switch-to.eu
description: A community-driven platform helping users switch from non-EU digital services to EU alternatives through clear, step-by-step migration guides.

paragraphs: A community-driven platform helping users switch from non-EU digital services to EU alternatives through clear, step-by-step migration guides.
Switch-to.eu empowers users to regain digital sovereignty by providing:
features: Migration Guides — step-by-step instructions to switch from non-EU services to EU alternatives
EU Alternative Listings — comprehensive database of EU digital services by category
Community Contributions — GitHub-based collaboration for content improvement and expansion

whatItDoes.text: A community-driven platform helping users switch from non-EU digital services to EU alternatives through clear, step-by-step migration guides.
